Context / Passage:
Each child in a group of four-year-old children was given the same puzzle to complete. The time taken (t) (in minutes) by each child to complete the puzzle is shown in the table below.

| Time taken (t) (in minutes) | Number of children |
| :---: | :---: |
| 2 < t ≤ 6 | 2 |
| 6 < t ≤ 10 | 10 |
| 10 < t ≤ 14 | 9 |
| 14 < t ≤ 18 | 7 |
| 18 < t ≤ 22 | 8 |
| 22 < t ≤ 26 | 7 |
| 26 < t ≤ 30 | 2 |

Please show me the complete step-by-step worked memorandum solution for this question (1 marks):
How many children completed the puzzle?
